simple.summary: קֹמֶץ (qômets) means a grasp , i.e. handful First listed occurrence: Gen 41 47.

definitions.full: H7062. qomets [ קֹ֫מֶץ ] noun [masculine] closed hand, fist ; — suffix קֻמְצוֺ מְלֹא his fist-full Lev 2:2 ; 5:12 ; take up ׳בְּק 6:8 in his fist (all P); plural לִקְמָצִים Gen 41:47 the earth yielded by handfuls (i.e. abundantly; E, according to most; P, Ball Holz, who questions text). קמשׂ (√ of following; meaning unknown).
